column1: habit|Small steps can lead to significant changes.|小小的行动可以带来显著的变化。|lead to 后接名词或动名词，表示“导致”。
habit|It takes time to develop a new habit.|养成一个新习惯需要时间。|It takes time to do sth.：做某事需要时间。
habit|Regular practice is more effective than occasional hard work.|有规律的练习比偶尔的苦练更有效。|比较级 more effective than；occasional 意为“偶尔的”。
habit|The more you review, the better you remember.|复习得越多，记得就越牢。|the＋比较级，the＋比较级：越……越……。
habit|Instead of reading the answer again, try to explain it yourself.|不要再读一遍答案，试着自己解释一下。|instead of 后接动名词；try to do 表示尝试做。
habit|A clear goal makes it easier to decide what to do next.|明确的目标使决定下一步做什么变得更容易。|make it＋形容词＋to do；it 是形式宾语。
habit|Even a short break can help you regain your focus.|即使短暂的休息也能帮助你重新集中注意力。|help sb. (to) do sth.；regain 表示重新获得。
habit|Do not expect every day to be perfect.|不要期待每一天都十全十美。|expect sb./sth. to do：预期某人或某物做……。
habit|What matters most is whether you keep going.|最重要的是你是否坚持下去。|What 引导主语从句；whether 引导表语从句。
habit|You are more likely to continue if the task is small enough.|如果任务足够小，你就更有可能坚持。|be likely to do：有可能做；形容词＋enough。
campus|The library provides students with a quiet place to study.|图书馆为学生提供了安静的学习场所。|provide sb. with sth.：向某人提供某物。
campus|Not all students prefer to study alone.|并不是所有学生都更喜欢独自学习。|not all 为部分否定，不是“所有人都不”。
campus|Students should have access to reliable information.|学生应该能够获取可靠的信息。|have access to：有机会使用或获取；to 是介词。
campus|The course is designed to develop practical skills.|这门课程旨在培养实用技能。|be designed to do：旨在做；注意被动结构。
campus|There is no need to compare your progress with everyone else's.|没有必要把自己的进度与其他所有人的进度比较。|There is no need to do；else's 表示“其他人的”。
campus|Many students find it difficult to balance study and work.|许多学生发现很难平衡学习和工作。|find it＋形容词＋to do；balance A and B。
campus|The project would not have succeeded without teamwork.|没有团队合作，这个项目就不会成功。|would not have done 表示对过去的虚拟推断。
campus|As long as we plan ahead, we can avoid unnecessary stress.|只要提前规划，我们就能避免不必要的压力。|as long as：只要；avoid 后常接名词或动名词。
campus|Some students learn better by discussing ideas with others.|一些学生通过与他人讨论想法学得更好。|by＋动名词表示方式。
campus|It is worth asking questions when something is unclear.|遇到不清楚的地方时，提问是值得的。|be worth doing：值得做，不能写 worth to do。
reading|The author does not reject the idea completely.|作者并没有完全否定这个观点。|completely 的位置会影响否定范围，留意部分否定。
reading|This example is used to support the main argument.|这个例子被用来支持主要论点。|be used to do：被用于做；不同于 be used to doing。
reading|The word refers to a change in people's attitudes.|这个词指的是人们态度的变化。|refer to：指的是；a change in：在……方面的变化。
reading|However, the evidence is not strong enough to support that conclusion.|然而，证据还不足以支持那个结论。|形容词＋enough＋to do；evidence 通常不可数。
reading|The passage focuses on the benefits of regular exercise.|这篇文章主要讨论有规律运动的益处。|focus on：重点在于；benefits of：……的益处。
reading|The finding suggests that the problem is more complex than expected.|这一发现表明，问题比预期更复杂。|suggest 在此表示“表明”，不是“建议”。
reading|We should consider both the advantages and the disadvantages.|我们应该同时考虑优点和缺点。|both A and B：A 和 B 两者都。
reading|The result depends on how the information is collected.|结果取决于信息的收集方式。|depend on 后可以接 how 引导的宾语从句。
reading|This does not necessarily mean that the method is useless.|这并不一定意味着这种方法毫无用处。|not necessarily：不一定；阅读中常用于限定结论。
reading|Compared with earlier studies, this survey includes more participants.|与早期研究相比，这项调查包含更多参与者。|Compared with 作比较状语；participants：参与者。
listening|The speaker has changed her mind about the trip.|说话者改变了对这次旅行的想法。|change one's mind：改变主意；留意转折后的新决定。
listening|I was going to call you, but my phone ran out of power.|我本来打算给你打电话，但手机没电了。|was going to：原本打算；run out of：用完。
listening|Would you mind turning the music down?|你介意把音乐调小声一点吗？|Would you mind 后接动名词。
listening|The meeting has been put off until next Friday.|会议已推迟到下周五。|put off：推迟；has been done 是现在完成时被动。
listening|You should have told me about the change earlier.|你本该早点告诉我这个变化。|should have done：过去本该做但未做。
listening|I would rather take the bus than drive in heavy traffic.|我宁愿坐公交，也不愿在拥堵的车流中开车。|would rather do A than do B。
listening|The train is due to arrive in ten minutes.|火车预计十分钟后到达。|be due to do：预计做；in ten minutes 表示十分钟后。
listening|There is little chance that we will finish before lunch.|我们午饭前完成的可能性很小。|little 表示“几乎没有”；chance that 后接同位语从句。
listening|I had no idea that the library closed so early.|我原先不知道图书馆这么早关门。|have no idea that：不知道……；听力中常表达意外。
listening|Why don't we ask the teacher for some advice?|我们为什么不向老师征求一些建议呢？|Why don't we do 用于提建议；advice 不可数。
writing|In my view, learning a language requires both practice and patience.|在我看来，学习一门语言既需要练习，也需要耐心。|In my view 用于表达观点；动名词短语作主语。
writing|One possible reason is that students have different learning needs.|一个可能的原因是学生的学习需求不同。|One possible reason is that... 可用于解释原因。
writing|For example, a short daily review can improve long-term memory.|例如，每天简短的复习可以改善长期记忆。|for example 后接具体例子，避免只重复观点。
writing|This approach not only saves time but also reduces waste.|这种方法不仅节省时间，还能减少浪费。|not only...but also... 连接两个谓语，主语为单数。
writing|Although technology offers convenience, it cannot solve every problem.|尽管技术带来了便利，但它不能解决所有问题。|Although 与 but 不要在同一个主从结构中重复使用。
writing|We need to strike a balance between efficiency and quality.|我们需要在效率和质量之间取得平衡。|strike a balance between A and B：在两者间取得平衡。
writing|It is important for students to take responsibility for their own learning.|学生对自己的学习负责是重要的。|It is＋形容词＋for sb. to do；take responsibility for。
writing|Rather than replacing teachers, digital tools can support them.|数字工具可以辅助教师，而不是取代教师。|Rather than 后的动名词短语表达对照。
writing|To address this problem, universities could offer more practical courses.|为了解决这个问题，大学可以开设更多实践课程。|To do 作目的状语；address 表示“处理、解决”。
writing|Therefore, small but consistent changes may be the best starting point.|因此，小而持续的改变可能是最好的起点。|therefore 表示因果结果；consistent：持续一致的。
translation|Public transport plays an important role in city life.|公共交通在城市生活中发挥着重要作用。|play an important role in：在……中起重要作用。
translation|More and more people are becoming aware of environmental protection.|越来越多的人开始意识到环境保护的重要性。|become aware of：意识到；environmental 为形容词。
translation|The city is famous for its long history and traditional culture.|这座城市以悠久的历史和传统文化而闻名。|be famous for：因……闻名；不同于 be famous as。
translation|With the development of technology, people's lives have changed greatly.|随着技术的发展，人们的生活发生了很大变化。|with＋名词短语作状语；发生至今的变化用现在完成时。
translation|The museum attracts visitors from all over the world.|这座博物馆吸引着来自世界各地的游客。|attract 为及物动词；from all over the world 修饰 visitors。
translation|This tradition has been passed down from generation to generation.|这一传统代代相传。|pass down：传承；has been done 表示被动。
translation|Online learning allows students to study at their own pace.|在线学习让学生可以按自己的节奏学习。|allow sb. to do；at one's own pace：按自己的节奏。
translation|The government has taken measures to improve public services.|政府已采取措施改善公共服务。|take measures to do：采取措施做某事。
translation|The festival provides an opportunity for families to get together.|这个节日为家人团聚提供了机会。|an opportunity for sb. to do：某人做某事的机会。
translation|Protecting cultural heritage is a responsibility shared by everyone.|保护文化遗产是每个人共同承担的责任。|动名词短语作主语；shared by everyone 是过去分词短语。
